```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(SportsAnalytics270)

library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

library(data.table)
```

# Competitive Balance

## Noll Scully number


```{r}
nhl_standings <- read.csv("./Teams.csv") %>%
  group_by(lgID) %>%
  arrange(year,rank) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(year < 2005)
nhl_standings$WR <- (nhl_standings$W + nhl_standings$T/2) / 
  (nhl_standings$W + nhl_standings$T + nhl_standings$L)
noll_scully <- nhl_standings %>%
  group_by(year, lgID) %>%
  summarize(NSN = sd(WR) / (0.5 / sqrt(n())) )
```
## Noll Scully number

\tiny
```{r, out.height="75%", fig.align='center'}
ggplot(noll_scully,aes(x = year, y = NSN)) +
  geom_line() +
  ggtitle("Noll-Skully number by season for each league") +
  ylab("Noll-Skully number") +
  facet_wrap(~lgID)
```

## Noll Scully number

\tiny
```{r, out.height="75%", fig.align='center'}
ggplot(noll_scully,aes(x = year, y = NSN)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  ggtitle("Noll-Skully number by season for each league") +
  ylab("Noll-Skully number") + 
  facet_wrap(~lgID)
```
# Individual performance

## Individual performance


```{r}
fifa23 <- read.csv("./Fifa 23 Players Data.csv")

fifa23 <- fifa23 %>%
  select(Best.Position, Preferred.Foot, Skill.Moves, Weak.Foot.Rating,
         Attacking.Work.Rate, Defensive.Work.Rate, Shooting.Total, Defending.Total,
         Passing.Total, Pace.Total, Height.in.cm., Weight.in.kg., 
         Goalkeeper.Reflexes, Goalkeeper.Diving, )
```

## One hot encoding for categorical variables

```{r}
fifa23 <- fifa23 %>%
  mutate(Preferred.Foot = as.factor(Preferred.Foot),
         Skill.Moves = as.factor(Skill.Moves),
         Weak.Foot.Rating = as.factor(Weak.Foot.Rating),
         Skill.Moves = as.factor(Skill.Moves),
         Attacking.Work.Rate = as.factor(Attacking.Work.Rate),
         Defensive.Work.Rate = as.factor(Defensive.Work.Rate)
         )
new_fifa <- one_hot(as.data.table(fifa23))
```

## Fitting a model

```{r}
fifa_players_train <- new_fifa %>%
  sample_frac(0.80)

fifa_players_test <- new_fifa %>% 
  anti_join(fifa_players_train)

mod.nnet <- nnet::multinom(
    Best.Position ~ .,
    data = fifa_players_train
)
cf.nnet <- coef(mod.nnet)
```

## Predicting on test set

```{r}
fifa_players_test$PrdPos <- predict(mod.nnet, newdata = fifa_players_test)
mean(fifa_players_test$PrdPos == fifa_players_test$Best.Position)
```
